column1: # OWASP ZAP Baseline Scan Rules File (.zap/rules.tsv) (#890)
# Every IGNORE entry MUST have a reviewed, written justification.
# 1. Critical Security Headers & Injections (FAIL on violation)

column3: Anti-clickjacking Header (X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors): Missing anti-clickjacking protection is treated as a critical failure.
X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing: Missing MIME-sniffing protection (nosniff) is treated as a critical failure.
Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set: Missing Content-Security-Policy header is treated as a critical failure.
Permissions-Policy Header Not Set: Missing Permissions-Policy header is treated as a critical failure.
Server Leaks Information via "Server" Header: Exposing detailed web server implementation details is treated as a failure.
Cross-Site Scripting (Reflected): Reflected input without proper HTML escaping is treated as a critical failure.
Cross Site Scripting (DOM Based): Unsanitized client-side injection is treated as a critical failure.
Application Error Disclosure: Internal stack traces or secrets leaking in response bodies is treated as a critical failure.
CSP - Wildcard Directive: Monitored for external asset sources.
Cross-Domain Misconfiguration: Monitored for unexpected external origin references.

column1: # 3. Documented Reviewed Ignores (IGNORE - each with written justification)

column3: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS): The local test and CI container environment runs over plain HTTP without TLS. In production, TLS termination and HSTS enforcement are handled upstream by reverse proxy/Cloudflare.

Incomplete or No Cache-Control and Pragma HTTP Header: Public static assets (Bootstrap CSS, icons, images, JS bundles) and login assets intentionally allow browser caching for performance. Sensitive routes use Cache-Control: no-store via apply_cache_headers.
Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments: Non-sensitive HTML template comments and contributor guidance are retained in non-sensitive client templates for developer onboarding.
Timestamp Disclosure: Epoch timestamps are exposed in non-sensitive public session timestamps and cache-busting asset query parameters.
CSP - style-src unsafe-inline: Required for inline styling in Bootstrap components, KaTeX math typesetting, dynamic theme cards, and email preview widgets.
Modern Web Application: Single-page application navigation patterns and AJAX endpoints are expected.
